name: Power
description: Battery glyph that shows when the charge limit holds the battery, with the percentage (a right click hides or shows it); a left click opens haseen.battery's power panel. Hidden without a battery. Adopted from the owner's t1nk33r.power; off by default, an alternative to the haseen.battery widget

showPercentage.description: Show the percentage beside the glyph (a right click on the widget toggles and saves it)
